name: Twilio Serverless Functions Monthly Free Invocations
free_limit: First 10,000 Twilio Serverless Functions invocations per month are free; additional invocations cost $0.0001 each.
watch_out: Twilio's initial trial expires after 30 days; continuing afterward requires upgrading to a billing-enabled pay-as-you-go account. The monthly free Functions allowance is separate from the expiring trial. Excess invocations are charged automatically, and other Twilio communication services may be billed separately. Card requirement for continued use and explicit commercial-use permission are not independently confirmed.
